catalog.name: Android phone
catalog.description: Your own Android phone: its screen, the apps you allow, the folders you pick.
catalog.hint: For what only your phone has: an app with no web version, a code that arrives as a notification, a photo or a file on it. The app on the phone shows when the agent is connected, and you can pause it from Quick Settings.

steps: Add the phone here: a QR code appears straight away, and `Connect` on its card brings it back later.
Install Intentic Device on the phone from intentic.dev/phone, then scan the code with the phone's camera.
Nothing is opened on your network: the phone connects out to this sandbox, and only while the agent needs it.
Choose on the phone which apps and folders the agent may use. Pause it from Quick Settings, or revoke it from this card, at any time.

catalog.name: Wear OS watch
catalog.description: Your own Wear OS watch: its screen, tiles and the apps you allow.
catalog.hint: For what only your watch has: a watch app you are building or testing, a tile, something on your wrist. The watch shows when the agent is connected, and you can pause it from its Intentic tile. It has no folders and no notification access to hand over.

steps: Add the watch here: a QR code appears straight away, and `Connect` on its card brings it back later.
Install Intentic Device on the watch: intentic.dev/watch says how (a watch has no browser, so it goes on from a computer, or your agent can install it through one).
A watch has no camera: scan the code with the phone the watch is paired with. Intentic Device on that phone sends it to the watch, which asks you before it pairs.
Choose on the watch which apps the agent may use. Pause it from the Intentic tile, or revoke it from this card, at any time.
